outline: Course Description: In the past, environmental engineering was a reactive profession, reacting to the problems created by the growth of world population and the increase in our standard of living. As the sustainability has become the desire of the mankind, environmental engineers, now and in the future, will play a key role in realizing sustainable development. Sometimes, environmental engineering is called sustainable engineering which transforms existing engineering disciplines and practices into those that promote sustainability. This course includes not just traditional environmental engineering but also covers the concept of cleaner production and pollution prevention. In addition, green chemistry, environmental ethics will also be taught in the class.
